nodes.Name: Jn
nodes.DocComment:
Jn returns the order-n Bessel function of the first kind.

Special cases are:

	Jn(n, ±Inf) = 0
	Jn(n, NaN) = NaN

nodes.Name: Yn
nodes.DocComment:
Yn returns the order-n Bessel function of the second kind.

Special cases are:

	Yn(n, +Inf) = 0
	Yn(n ≥ 0, 0) = -Inf
	Yn(n < 0, 0) = +Inf if n is odd, -Inf if n is even
	Yn(n, x < 0) = NaN
	Yn(n, NaN) = NaN
